name: Fossify Music Player
tagline: A clean, ad-free music player for the songs on your phone
description:
Fossify Music Player is a simple, good-looking app for playing the music files already on your phone. It has a customizable home-screen widget and a stylish interface, with no ads and no hidden trackers.

It is part of the Fossify suite of apps, which is a fork of the popular Simple Mobile Tools apps, kept alive and open source.
